sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in Special Case No.446 of 2017, pending in the file of the learned ADJ-cum-Spl. Court under POCSO Act, Balasore, arising out of Town P.S. Case No.293 of 2017 for commission of alleged offences under Sections 363/376/511/379/506/34 of IPC read with Section 8 of POCSO Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned ADJ-cum-Spl. Court under POCSO Act, Balasore by order dated 02.05.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner was granted bail by the learned Court in seisin on 06.04.2022 but because of his non appearance on the date fixed, he has been taken into custody on 24.04.2023 on execution of NBW(A) and it is stated that he is in custody since then.
5. Ex facie, this Court does not find any infirmity in the order so passed.

6. Considering the submission of the learned counsel that the non-appearance was for reasons beyond the control of the petitioner and not willful and keeping in view the role ascribed to the petitioner, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the learned Court in seisin.
8. It is further directed that in addition to the sureties so fixed, one of the sureties shall be immediate member of the family who shall execute a P.R. bond.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
10. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rule.
